bio.text: Critter Milton is the Unity Party candidate for Colorado's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He earned a degree from the University of Denver in 2006 and attended the College for Financial Planning for graduate study.
He was previously the Unity Party candidate for U.S. House in Colorado's 3rd District in 2020, the 7th District in 2022 and the 1st District in 2024.
